transactions.desc: Atlanta designated Falter for assignment Monday.
Atlanta recalled Murphy from Triple-A Gwinnett on Monday.
The Phillies optioned Holman to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Sunday.
The Phillies activated Banks (forearm) from the 60-day injured list Monday.
The Phillies designated Cairo for assignment Sunday.
The Rangers optioned Cauley to Triple-A Round Rock on Sunday.
The Rangers recalled Osuna from Triple-A Round Rock on Sunday.
The Orioles recalled Hiraldo from Triple-A Norfolk on Sunday.
The Diamondbacks recalled Fernandez from Triple-A Reno on Sunday.

The Guardians optioned Aleman to Triple-A Columbus on Sunday.
The Nationals activated Nunez (personal) from the bereavement list Sunday.

The Athletics optioned Estes to Triple-A Las Vegas on Sunday.
The Athletics recalled Rom from Triple-A Las Vegas on Sunday.

The Royals claimed Bivens off waivers from the Giants on Saturday.
The Nationals optioned Yean to Triple-A Rochester on Saturday.

The Rangers reinstated Jung (calf) from the injured list Saturday.
